model_meta.system_name: Gerotor pump with reversible fluid routing
model_meta.description: Concept model of an eccentric gerotor pump with a turnable supply tube routing pressure medium between two sockets.

subsystems.description: Pump housing with first and second supply sockets.

Inner lobed rotor engages the separately represented outer rotor on eccentric axes. Its radial conduits communicate the high- and low-pressure sections of the chamber between the rotors with respective shaft-cylinder openings.
Fixed to the central drive shaft and supports the inner rotor eccentrically; axially displaced cylinder openings communicate with high- and low-pressure sections.

Contains two supply lines with opposed sub-lines, axially displaced groups of inner supply openings, and two outer feeding openings. The supply-opening groups communicate through respective sealed annular spaces formed between the tube and shaft cylinder; three sealing rings form the two mutually sealed spaces. Tube rotation selects corresponding socket paths, crossed paths, or direct interconnection between the two feeding openings.

steps.description: Drive shaft rotation turns the eccentric shaft cylinder, causing the engaged inner rotor to wander within the outer rotor.

Pressure medium passes from the low- and high-pressure chamber sections through radial conduits and respective shaft-cylinder openings into sealed spaces, then through corresponding supply-tube openings and lines to selected feeding openings and sockets.
Turn the supply tube to select corresponding socket connections, crossed socket connections, or direct interconnection of feed openings.
